name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos. Every spring, the PTA hosts a second book fair to promote summer reading. This year, they're continuing their partnership with the local children's bookstore, Hicklebee's, who will provide the books.

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos Deadline
description: 5th grade parents need to submit their child's baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages in the yearbook by March 31st.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. The PTA is looking for volunteers to come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during this time to help. Training is provided.

name: PTA Board Positions for 2026-27
description: The PTA is looking for members of the Los Alamitos community to join the PTA Executive Board for the 2026-27 school year. Various board positions are available.

name: Nowruz (Iranian New Year) Staff Luncheon
description: The Iranian community hosted a luncheon for the Los Alamitos staff in celebration of Nowruz, the Persian New Year and first day of spring. It's a holiday symbolizing renewal, hope, and new beginnings.

name: Math Kangaroo
description: The PTA hosted the first Math Kangaroo test at Los Alamitos. It was a success with 54 students participating in the global competition that promotes problem-solving and critical thinking.
